history.period: Modern (built in recent decades with Bokaro Steel Plant management support; exact consecration year not documented in consulted sources)
history.summary: A modern Kalinga-style temple closely modelled on the Jagannath Temple of Puri, built in white marble with the support of the Bokaro Steel Plant management. The sanctum houses Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra; smaller shrines are dedicated to Shiva, Ganesha, Hanuman and the Navagraha. It is known locally for its evening aarti and an annual Rath Yatra in which the three deities are taken around the temple premises in decorated chariots. The temple was already established by 2007, when a visitor photograph of it was uploaded to Wikimedia Commons; the exact founding year is not stated in the sources consulted (flag: verify with temple authorities).

town_description: Bokaro Steel City is a planned industrial city in Bokaro district, Jharkhand, built around the Bokaro Steel Plant, one of India's major steel plants. Its numbered sectors host a large migrant workforce and community from across India.
